import os,re,collections,heapq,json
def load():

    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def fill(g):

                    n=[g[x][y] for x,y in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)) if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and g[x][y]!=0]
                    if n: g[r][c]=n[0]; ch=True
    return g

def comps(g,bg):
    seen=set(); out=[]

            if g[r][c]!=bg and (r,c) not in seen:

                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop(); comp.append((a,b))
                    for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        x,y=a+dx,b+dy
                        if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and g[x][y]!=bg and (x,y) not in seen:
                            seen.add((x,y)); st.append((x,y))
                out.append(comp)
    return out

    res=[row[:] for row in F]
    placed=set()
    order=others
    for cs in order:
        col=F[cs[0][0]][cs[0][1]]
        best=(float('inf'),None)
        # try all dr,dc: slide up-left as far as possible
        moves=[]
        for dr in range(-max(R) if False else max(r for r,c in cs)-min(r for r,c in cs)+1,0,-1):
            pass
        # fallback greedy: shift up until hit wall/object, then left similarly

        r0=min(r for r,c in cells); c0=min(c for r,c in cells)
        # shift up
        rr=[r for r,c in cells]
        h=max(rr)
        dh=h
        while True:

            ok=all(0<=rr and rr<H and (rr,cc) not in placed and rr>=0 for rr,cc in shifted)
            if not ok: break
            dh+=1
        cc=[c for r,c in cells]

            ok=all(0<=c2 for rr,c2 in shifted) and all((rr,c2) not in placed for rr,c2 in shifted)

        final=[(rr,cc-dc) for rr,cc in [(r,dh) for r,c in cells]]

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

import numpy as np
def load():
    import os,re
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

import numpy as np, collections
def comps(g,bg):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; out=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if not seen[r][c] and g[r][c]!=bg:
                col=g[r][c]; st=[(r,c)]; seen[r][c]=True; cells=[]
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop(); cells.append((a,b))
                    for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        x,y=a+dx,b+dy
                        if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and not seen[x][y] and g[x][y]==col:
                            seen[x][y]=True; st.append((x,y))
                out.append(cells)
    return out
def compcolor(c,g): return g[c[0][0]][c[0][1]]
def solve(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; H,W=len(g),len(g[0])

def comps(g,bg):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; out=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if not seen[r][c] and g[r][c]!=bg:
                st=[(r,c)]; seen[r][c]=True; cells=[]
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop(); cells.append((a,b))
                    for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        x,y=a+dx,b+dy
                        if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and not seen[x][y] and g[x][y]==g[r][c]:
                            seen[x][y]=True; st.append((x,y))
                out.append(cells)
    return out

    keepr=[r for r in range(len(out)) if any(out[r][b]!=bg for b in keepc)]
    final=[[out[r][c] for c in keepc] for r in keepr]
    return final

import os,re,collections
from collections import Counter, deque
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
# print demo2 compactly, mark cells
for p in [2]:
    I_=G[f'Demo pair {p} input']; O_=G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    H,W=len(I_),len(I_[0]); oh,ow=len(O_),len(O_[0])
    print(f'--- demo{p} in{H}x{W} out{oh}x{ow}')
    for r in range(max(H,oh)):
        line=''.join(map(str,I_[r])) if r<H else ''
        oline=''.join(map(str,O_[r])) if r<oh else ''
        print(r,line,'   ','OUT',oline)

import os,re,json,itertools
from collections import Counter, deque
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])

        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]

    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/01a1889d-eb39-731a-baf1-a94ccf315544.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
